fato_historico: 1954: Alger Hiss is released from prison after serving 44 months for perjury.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a meaningful release of old burdens, much like walking out of a long, shadowy tunnel into the bright, open air. Consider this a potent time to reclaim your personal freedom and truth. It is a good time to shed outdated perceptions and embrace the liberating power of a new, authentic chapter in your life.
frase_do_dia: True freedom begins when you choose to release the weight of the past.
significado_numero: Represents stability, grounding, and the closing of important life cycles.
conselho: Trust your inner wisdom and step forward with confidence into your new path.
